name: the-dark-side-dev
description: Dev-only frontend tooling for the-dark-side static app.

scripts.check:web: for f in web/*.js web/*.mjs; do node --check "$f"; done
scripts.test:web: node --test tests/test_gpx.mjs && node --test tests/test_editor_state.mjs && node --test tests/test_route_planner.mjs && node --test tests/test_route_scenarios.mjs
scripts.test:frontend: npm run test:web && npm run check:web && npm run test:e2e
